obligation: Condition affecting safety of project works: initial report
trigger: A security incident (physical and/or cyber), misoperation of a gate or other water release facility, or unusual instrument readings at any of the 4 projects
deadline: As soon as practicable after the condition is discovered, preferably within 72 hours, without unduly interfering with emergency action
notify: FERC Regional Engineer by email or telephone
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - FERC licensee for all 4 projects

obligation: Condition affecting safety of project works: written report
trigger: After the initial report
deadline: Within the time the Regional Engineer specifies; verified under 12.13; causes, preceding events, measures taken, damage, injuries, property damage
applies_at_this_tier: Yes

obligation: Deaths, serious injuries, or rescues at the project
trigger: Any death, serious injury, or rescue at the project works or involving project operation (for example a surge from an unauthorized gate opening)
deadline: Initial report promptly after discovery; written report for project-related events
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if any occur

obligation: Security incident or suspicious activity report to FERC
citation: FERC Security Program Rev. 3A, sec. 3.2 and 4.2
trigger: Suspicious activity or a security incident at a project, unless law enforcement restricts reporting
deadline: As soon as practical (usually within one working day)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - all 4 projects; can be combined with the 12.10 initial report

obligation: Suspicious activity report to the HSIN Dams portal
trigger: Suspicious activity or incident, regardless of apparent significance
deadline: No deadline stated; report promptly
notify: DHS Homeland Security Information Network suspicious activity tool
applies_at_this_tier: Voluntary but highly recommended; account held by the Corporate Security Manager

obligation: Local law enforcement and emergency management
citation: FERC Security Program Rev. 3A, sec. 4.2 and 7.4.1
trigger: Serious security incident, including any unauthorized control of gates or units
deadline: Immediately, in parallel: law enforcement for the adversary; emergency management if people downstream may be at risk
notify: County sheriff (911) and county emergency management in the affected county (3 counties)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - company procedure in each Security Plan

obligation: Emergency Action Plan notifications
trigger: Impending or actual sudden release of water (project emergency, 12.3(b)(9))
deadline: Per the EAP notification flowchart (immediate)
notify: Downstream residents through sirens; county emergency management; agencies listed in each EAP
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if the event becomes a project emergency
clock_starts: Recognition of a potential or actual emergency
owner: Chief Dam Safety Engineer (ROC shift supervisor may activate)

obligation: Other dam owners in the drainage basin, including RMOS clients
trigger: Security situation that could affect other dam owners (including any incident on the ROC or an RMOS tunnel)
deadline: As quickly as possible
notify: Other dam owners on the PNH and SGR rivers; the 4 RMOS client duty contacts
applies_at_this_tier: Yes
owner: ROC Manager (company dams); Vice President of Hydro Services (clients)

obligation: Temporary closure of recreation facilities for security
trigger: Closing recreation areas or project use for security reasons for 30 days or less
deadline: As soon as practical (usually within one working day); closures over 30 days need prior coordination
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if recreation areas are closed

obligation: Reportable Cyber Security Incident notice for low impact BES Cyber Systems
trigger: Cyber Security Incident at the ROC, backup ROC, BWB, or CDS determined to be a Reportable Cyber Security Incident under the CIP-003 plan
deadline: The standard sets no fixed deadline for low impact; company rule: within 24 hours of the determination
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - GO and GOP with low impact BES Cyber Systems
clock_starts: Determination that the incident is reportable

obligation: EOP-004-4 event report
trigger: Damage or destruction of a BES Facility (BWB, CDS) from actual or suspected intentional human action; physical threat that could degrade operation, or a suspicious device or activity at the Facility
deadline: By the later of 24 hours after recognizing the event type threshold or the end of the next business day (4 p.m. local time)
notify: Entities in the EOP-004 Operating Plan (ERO, Regional Entity, BA/TOP, law enforcement); EOP-004 Attachment 2 or the DOE-OE-417 form
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - GO and GOP (BWB, CDS, and the ROC)
clock_starts: Recognition of meeting an event type threshold

obligation: DOE-417 Electric Emergency Incident and Disturbance Report
trigger: Events meeting a DOE-417 criterion (for example a cyber event that causes interruptions of electrical system operations, or an attempted cyber compromise)
deadline: Emergency Alert (criteria 1-9): within 1 hour; Normal Report (10-13): within 6 hours; attempted cyber compromise (criterion 14): by the end of the next calendar day after determination; System Report (15-27): later of 24 hours or end of next business day; final report within 72 hours
notify: DOE (and as directed by the form)
applies_at_this_tier: To be confirmed: the company has not confirmed whether a generation-only GO and GOP is a required DOE-417 respondent; the NERC Compliance Manager confirms against the form instructions by 2026-12-31. The BA/TOP files for its area

obligation: NERC CIP-008-6 R4 Reportable Cyber Security Incident notification
trigger: Reportable Cyber Security Incident on high or medium impact BES Cyber Systems
deadline: Within 1 hour after determination; attempts by end of next calendar day
applies_at_this_tier: No - the company has only low impact BES Cyber Systems (P03 G-081, G-102); low impact notice is under CIP-003-9 Section 4.2

obligation: CIRCIA covered cyber incident report / ransom payment report (PROPOSED - not yet in effect)
trigger: Covered cyber incident or ransom payment
deadline: Proposed: 72 hours; 24 hours after ransom payment
applies_at_this_tier: No - final rule not published as of 2026-09-25; recheck when final

obligation: Voluntary cyber incident report to FBI and CISA
citation: FERC Security Program Rev. 3A, sec. 9.4 (coordination with authorities such as the FBI)
trigger: Suspected cyber intrusion into control systems or a ransomware event
deadline: As soon as possible; no regulatory deadline
applies_at_this_tier: Voluntary; strongly advised; also a mitigating factor for OFAC
owner: OT Security Manager (OT) or IT Director (IT), through counsel

obligation: Florida breach notice to individuals
trigger: Breach of security of personal information of Florida residents (for example employee records taken in a ransomware event)
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination of the breach (up to 15 more days for good cause, notice to individuals only)
applies_at_this_tier: Only if personal information is involved

obligation: Florida notice to the Department of Legal Affairs
trigger: Breach affecting 500 or more individuals in Florida
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination of the breach
applies_at_this_tier: Only if 500 or more Florida residents are affected

obligation: Florida notice to consumer reporting agencies
trigger: Notice to more than 1,000 individuals at one time
deadline: Without unreasonable delay
applies_at_this_tier: Only if more than 1,000 individuals

obligation: Third-party agent notice to the company
trigger: A vendor maintaining company personal information (HR, payroll, benefits) has a breach
deadline: Vendor must notify the company within 10 days of determining the breach
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - applies to the company vendors

obligation: State data breach notification (other states)
citation: State breach notification statutes (all 50 states, DC, PR, USVI; Guam 9 GCA Ch. 48)
trigger: Breach of personal information of residents of other states (field services and PNH staff living in Georgia and Alabama)
deadline: Varies by state
notify: Affected residents; state regulators where required
applies_at_this_tier: Always check; apply the law of each state where affected individuals reside

obligation: OFAC sanctions check before any ransom payment
citation: OFAC Updated Advisory on Potential Sanctions Risks for Facilitating Ransomware Payments (Sept. 21, 2021); 31 CFR ch. V
trigger: Considering a ransom payment
deadline: Before any payment; full and timely reporting to law enforcement or CISA is a mitigating factor
notify: OFAC (license if a sanctioned party is involved); FBI or CISA
applies_at_this_tier: All U.S. persons

obligation: Covered telecommunications equipment or Kaspersky article discovered
trigger: Contractor identifies covered equipment or a Kaspersky covered article
deadline: Within 1 business day for covered telecommunications (52.204-25(d)); within 3 business days for a Kaspersky covered article (52.204-23(c)); further report within 10 business days in both cases
applies_at_this_tier: No - the company holds no federal contracts or subcontracts

obligation: BA/TOP notice of unit or data unavailability
citation: BA/TOP operating agreement and PPA (contract); GOP duty to follow BA/TOP instructions
trigger: Loss of ICCP data, loss of control of BWB or CDS units, or a change in availability
deadline: Immediately by voice from the ROC; then per the agreement
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual and operational

obligation: RMOS client notice
citation: RMOS contracts (security schedule from 2027; current practice)
trigger: Any incident affecting a client connection, client data, or the ROC ability to operate client works
deadline: Immediately by phone for operational impact; written notice within 24 hours
notify: Client duty contact and client security contact
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual

obligation: Electric cooperative offtaker notice
trigger: Event affecting PNH or SGR scheduled output
deadline: Per contract (call the cooperative control desk for schedule changes)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual

obligation: Cyber insurance claim notice
trigger: Suspected security incident
deadline: Per policy: carrier hotline before engaging vendors
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual

obligation: Board audit committee and PE sponsor
trigger: Severity 1 incident (any OT incident affecting gates or units, or a ransomware event)
deadline: Within 4 hours of declaration
notify: Audit committee chair; sponsor operating partner
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - internal governance
